verdict.rationale: Cloudflare ships an official command-line tool, Wrangler, for creating, developing, deploying and rolling back Workers, and its commands can be scripted via package.json. The docs claim fit with GitHub Actions, and API tokens are documented for CI/CD automation, though that token guidance is stated for the MCP server. The evidence never explicitly documents running Wrangler non-interactively in a CI pipeline, so coverage of the story is partial. Missing for 10: explicit docs for headless/non-interactive Wrangler auth and deploys in CI, a documented GitHub Actions workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
